card.name: Digits and unit starts before measures
card.fires_on: Numbers (or the start of a unit word like centi- or milli-) just before a measurement unit such as km, mL, inch or mCi. It fires where the next word is expected to be a unit of length or volume.

modes.label: Digit before a unit
modes.description: A digit in a quantity where a unit like km, mL or inch comes next.

modes.label: Start of a unit word
modes.description: The first piece of a metric unit word such as centimeters, kilometers or milligram.

card.writes: It promotes unrelated odd tokens and suppresses unit words like kilometers, meters, miles and minutes, so it seems to hold back repeating a unit.
card.plain: It marks a number or unit start in a measurement, right before the unit is given.
